class.name: IfcFan
class.brief_description: A fan is a device which imparts mechanical work on a gas. A typical usage of a fan is to induce airflow in a building services air distribution system. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcFan defines the occurrence of any fan; common information about fan types is handled by IfcFanType .
